answer: Require each identity to present one employer payroll attestation: a payroll provider confirms an active paid employee record, and the platform stores only a hash of employer plus payroll ID, so reuse is rejected. A sybil farmer needs a real job, with tax withholding, for every fake — costly and traceable, since payroll leaves a violet paper trail no duplicate can hide. Genuine employment is the beacon: one person, one paycheck, signed by the employer's quill. Limit: it excludes the unemployed and informal workers, so it must complement other checks, not replace them.
